verdict.rationale: Formant has a dedicated docs page, "Trigger webhooks from events" [formant-docs-28]. It says a webhook makes an HTTP API call to any endpoint when a Formant event fires, which is a registrable outbound callback a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is a single line, though, so beyond the core mechanism it says little about depth or how robust it is. Missing for 10: payload/schema documentation, event-type filtering details, delivery guarantees (retries, signing/auth), API-based webhook registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
